name: Deflect Attacks
desc: As a Reaction, you reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from an attack against you by 1d10 {dexMod} (Dex) +{level} (Monk level). If the damage is reduced to 0, you can spend 1 Focus Point to redirect it at a creature within 5 feet (Dexterity saving throw, damage = 2 Martial Arts dice + Dex).
